transcript: Speaker A (Narrator): [At her husband's office party, the HR asked Meera what she does. Meera struggled to answer in English, leading to embarrassment.] Speaker B (HR): Hi, you must be Rahul's wife. So nice to finally meet you. What do you do? Speaker C (Meera): I... home... काम... घर में. [I... home... work... at home.] Speaker B (HR): Oh, that's nice. Speaker D (Boss's Wife): Hi dear, where are you from? Speaker C (Meera): मैं जयपुर से. [I am from Jaipur.] Speaker D (Boss's Wife): Oh, lovely! Jaipur is beautiful. Do you work or... Speaker E (Husband): Sorry, she's a bit tired today. Speaker A (Narrator): [Humiliated, Meera cried and downloaded the English Seekho app. She practiced daily with the AI coach.] Speaker C (Meera): My name is Meera. I am from Jaipur. I am a homemaker. My husband works at Infosys. We have been married for one year. Speaker A (Narrator): [Three months later at the Diwali party, Meera spoke English confidently, impressing everyone.] Speaker D (Boss's Wife): Meera, so good to see you again! How have you been? Speaker C (Meera): I've been great, thank you. We recently went to Udaipur for our anniversary. The Lake Palace was absolutely beautiful. Have you been there? Speaker D (Boss's Wife): Oh, wow! No, I haven't. You have to tell me more. Speaker A (Narrator): [Her husband felt proud. Meera urges others to download the app for a 1-rupee trial.] Speaker F (Male Voiceover): तो इंस्टॉल बटन पे क्लिक करो और English Seekho ऐप डाउनलोड करो. [So click on the install button and download the English Seekho app.]
summary: A homemaker feels embarrassed at her husband's office party due to her poor English skills. She downloads the English Seekho app, practices daily with the AI coach, and confidently converses in English at the next party. The ad promotes a 1-rupee trial and urges users to install the app.
